name: PDH/PDL Retest with Trailing Stop
description: Previous Day High/Low retest strategy. Native 15min breakout detection (no resample_tf), ATR trailing stop, 24h signal window. Grid searches retracement level (38-70%), range mode (session vs all-hours), and trail parameters.
hypothesis: PDH/PDL breakouts with retracement entry and trailing stop capture trend continuation while protecting gains. Removing resample delay and trading 24h increases signal count. ATR trail adapts to volatility.
expected_outcome: Significantly more trades than v1 (removed hourly delay + 24h signals). Trailing stop should improve risk-adjusted returns vs fixed TP.
